observations: body L1: the sentence begun on p. 247 goes on: «Sed Ptolemaeum aequatorem in 12 partes aequales (30 graduum, scilicet binarum horarum aequinoctialium) divisisse».
body L6: the rough breathings of «ὡροσκοποῦσα» and «ὡροσκόπος» are printed; specks over the ρ of «ὡροσκόπος» and over the comma after «ṭāli‘)» are not transcribed.

body L8-L11, L17-L18, L26: the dashes of «al–arḍ», «ar–rābi‘», «al–ghārib», «as–samā’», «al–‘āshir», «’l–Wafā’», «145–», «–146», «195–196» and «al–Battānī» are long dashes (4.8 to 5.5 pt); the dash after «dens.» measures 9.1 pt.

body L21-L32: the figure stands on the left of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the meridian PSP′N (radius 74.4 pt), the horizon NES through its centre, the equator BB′ and the ecliptic from IV through A to X as arcs of circles of radius 241.6 and 232.2 pt, and the five circles of declination through the poles P and P′ and the points 11, 12, a, 2 and 3 of the equator. Filled dots mark the cusps on the equator (B′ = 10, 11, 12, a, 2, 3, B = 4) and on the ecliptic (X, XI, XII, A, II, III, IV), radius 1.1 to 1.5 pt; the crossings at E and at the sign of Aries have none. The words X domus to III domus stand in the gores, letter by letter along curved lines, and the numerals of the equator are turned; all are set as measured.

body L21-L32: as drawn, P and P′, N and S, IV and X lie nearly opposite on the meridian (their midpoints 0.8, 0.3 and 2.1 pt from its centre), B and B′ do not (11.9 pt); E stands at the centre (0.4 pt off), and the horizon, the ecliptic and the circle of declination of A meet in one point, the dot at A. The horizon falls 1.4 pt from N to S. A short stroke on the meridian below P and a speck at its left edge are not drawn.
body L23: the sign of Aries is printed «♈» in the figure and in the text.
body L26-L32: the arc aB′ is the semidiurnal arc of A and aB the seminocturnal: a is where the circle of declination through A meets the equator (note 3).

notes_left L1-L2: the circumflexes of «Abû» and «Bûzdjâni» print as single strokes, like the acute of «Wéfa»; the title is printed «d’Abû ’l-Wéfa» here (on p. 183 and p. 224 «d’Aboû»); kept as printed. The hyphens of «’l-Wéfa» and «al-Bûzdjâni» measure 3.0 and 3.2 pt.
notes_right L1-L2: a speck between the l and the a of «Delambre» is not transcribed; the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 8.8 pt; his name is divided «Schia-parelli» in small capitals.
notes_right L3-L4: Schiaparelli's addition (note 3) goes on to p. 249.
